title: The dimension of the localization at a prime is the length of the longest chain of primes below it
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $\mathfrak p\subset R$ a prime ideal and $R_{\mathfrak p}$ the localization of $R$ at $\mathfrak p$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Then the Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] of $R_{\mathfrak p}$ is the supremum, in $\{0,1,2,\ldots,\infty\}$, of the integers $t\ge0$ for which there is a chain $\mathfrak p_0\subsetneq\mathfrak p_1\subsetneq\cdots\subsetneq\mathfrak p_t$ of prime ideals of $R$ with $\mathfrak p_t\subseteq\mathfrak p$ (the height of $\mathfrak p$).
